title: Fresh active parent session is valid
Locked account invalidates existing session
sql: UPDATE accounts SET status='LOCKED' WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('parent'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true(NOT valid_session('test-session-digest'),'locked'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true((SELECT auth_epoch=2 FROM accounts WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('parent')),'epoch increment');

title: Idle expiry is independent of absolute expiry
sql: UPDATE auth_sessions SET last_seen_at=now()-interval '25 hours' WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('test-session'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true(NOT valid_session('test-session-digest'),'idle');

title: Old epoch denies a session even without revoked_at
sql: UPDATE accounts SET auth_epoch=2 WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('parent'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true(NOT valid_session('test-session-digest'),'epoch');

title: Auth epoch cannot decrease
sql: UPDATE accounts SET auth_epoch=0 WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('parent');

title: Challenge consume returns account once
Wrong purpose cannot consume challenge
sql: SELECT pg_temp.assert_true(consume_auth_challenge(repeat('d',64),'VERIFY_EMAIL') IS NULL,'purpose'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true((SELECT consumed_at IS NULL FROM auth_challenges WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('challenge')),'unconsumed');

title: Expired challenge cannot be consumed
Reset challenge TTL over fifteen minutes is rejected
Correct verified student invitation accepted
Wrong student email cannot accept invitation
sql: UPDATE accounts SET email_digest='wrong-digest' WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('student-account');UPDATE student_invitations SET state='ACCEPTED',accepted_by=pg_temp.tid('student-account'),accepted_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('invite');

title: Parent role cannot receive student link
Invitation cannot be attached to another parent
Invitation over twenty four hours is rejected
Pending invitation is unique per child
Accepted invitation cannot be reopened
setup: INSERT INTO student_invitations(id,student_id,parent_id,target_email_digest,token_digest,expires_at,state) VALUES(pg_temp.tid('invite'),pg_temp.tid('student'),pg_temp.tid('parent'),'student-email-digest',repeat('e',64),now()+interval '24 hours','PENDING');UPDATE student_invitations SET state='ACCEPTED',accepted_by=pg_temp.tid('student-account'),accepted_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('invite');

title: Assigned independent verifier accepted
Tutor cannot verify own profile
Unassigned verifier is rejected
Owner can grant limited source access to assigned support
Support grant cannot exceed twenty four hours
Support cannot grant access to itself
Revoked source cannot receive new support grant
setup: INSERT INTO support_cases(id,reporter_id,category,description,state,assignee_id) VALUES(pg_temp.tid('case'),pg_temp.tid('parent'),'PRIVACY','Synthetic case','IN_PROGRESS',pg_temp.tid('support'));INSERT INTO support_grant_requests(id,case_id,requester_id,material_version_id,purpose,requested_until,state) VALUES(pg_temp.tid('greq'),pg_temp.tid('case'),pg_temp.tid('support'),pg_temp.tid('mv1'),'Inspect source',now()+interval '2 hours','APPROVED');UPDATE material_versions SET state='REVOKED' WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('mv1');

title: Support case cannot jump from processing straight to closed
